name: Pixel Game
tagline: A retro pixel-art arcade game that reskins an old classic with a news story, made for vertical video: autoplay, replays, share cards.
youSay: /pixel-game turn Tesla's flying Roadster reveal into Flappy Bird
whatYouGet: A playable arcade game on one page: an old classic reskinned with your story, its cast drawn as pixel caricatures from real photos, with its own logo, music and sound
Made for vertical video: a 9:16 screen with the action mid-frame, an autopilot or CPU mode for hands-off B-roll, instant replays rebuilt from the run, and a 1080×1920 share card
Game feel and jokes built in: neon bloom, hit-stop, shake, slow-motion close calls, and a stamp and punchline on every loss
Proof it works: headless runs that show the game is fair and beatable, screenshots of every screen, and frame-exact demo videos with the game's own soundtrack
goodFit: Parodies of this week's news, launches and rivalries for TikTok, Reels and X
Creators and brands who want a playable meme or a launch-day mini game
notFor: Big games with levels to save, accounts or online play
3D games, or games built on real photos or video
youBring: The story, product or in-joke, and the old game it should feel like (or ask for ideas)
Optional: photos of who or what is in it, names, colours and jokes
needs: Node 18+ for the checks and screenshots

network.purpose: two pixel fonts for the page beside the game
Playwright for the tools, installed once
